claim: G29 R5: native request-shape comparison may select one tiny no-schema Nemotron diagnostic that distinguishes ordinary inference health from response-schema failure; only its exact sentinel permits at most two no-schema, sentinel-bounded candidate products under unchanged qualification.
non_claims: No persistent LM Studio setting change, remote model, qwen retry, permissive output repair, G30 mock result, live Mattermost contact, credentials, adapter activation, production readiness, promotion, or complete Soul cognition. A successful sentinel does not imply a valid candidate.
rationale: R4 proved the exact explicit preload succeeds but both strict JSON-schema requests still terminate with correlated crashes. The model works in ordinary LM Studio use according to the operator. One minimal no-schema sentinel request is the smallest experiment that can discriminate general inference failure from grammar-constrained inference failure before spending longer artifact calls.
reading: Retain unchanged controls and ledger. Reread R4 plan/outcome, exact preload/unload observations, strict-schema error streams and crash metadata; R2 exact candidate/test consequences; model profile; WORK_PROTOCOL effect/recovery constraints; and ACCEPTANCE G29/G30.
representation: Request-shape experiment atoms separate model, schema disposition, prompt scope, expected evidence, diagnostic power, reversibility and grant. Native set comparison returns selected or unresolved standing. Load, diagnostic, product, extraction and unload observations remain separate. Exact source bytes are admitted only from a single sentinel envelope.
consumer: G29 MeTTa owns experiment comparison, diagnostic consequence, whether artifact requests may proceed, repair targets, assembly, qualification and continuation. Prolog invokes the exact allowlisted local CLI, captures process/model state, transports local requests, enforces exact sentinels, quarantines source, and runs syntax/tests. JavaScript freezes and independently verifies only.
falsifiers: Order changes experiment selection; removal still proceeds; equally supported experiments first-match; artifact calls occur after a failed or non-exact diagnostic; response_format appears; sentinel extraction accepts duplicates, absence, reversal, fences or explanatory text; load uses another model or persistent configuration; baseline changes; calls exceed three; or invalid, credential-bearing, direct-core, test-failing source qualifies or is promoted.
scope_review: One transient explicit Nemotron load/unload; one no-schema diagnostic at 64 tokens/120 seconds; and only after exact success, at most two no-schema source calls at 2048 tokens/300 seconds/2 MiB. No persistent setting, remote model, qwen, credential, Mattermost network, production activation, push, or hand-authored candidate repair.
rollback: R1-R4 evidence and claims remain immutable. A failed diagnostic stops before artifact calls. Any generation or extraction failure is preserved exactly. R5 writes only new G29 evidence/runtime quarantine and G29 tooling. No candidate promotion or core modification.
